functions.name: accept_engagement
functions.doc:
The agent consents to a proposed job: its bond share, the vault share
 and the per-agent exposure are locked now, against the amounts fixed
 in the proposal. Refused if they no longer fit, if the coverage moved
 to another vault or expired, if the deadline has passed, or while
 paused.

functions.name: appeal
functions.doc:
Appeals a resolved quality claim. Only the client or the agent may appeal.
 Attaches the appeal stake (`claim_stake_bps` of the claim amount).
 Can only be called within the appeal window. Freezes the claim for council decision.

functions.name: bind_coverage
functions.doc:
The caller's vault agrees to back `agent` up to `limit` locked at a
 time, at `premium_bps` of each job's liability, until `expires_at`.

 Phase 1 stand-in for the sealed-bid market (Phase 4 `settle_round`
 writes the same record). Only the vault's own underwriter can commit
 its capital, the rate can never be below the agent's premium floor, and
 a vault cannot displace another vault's live coverage. Engagements
 record their own vault, so rebinding never affects open work.

functions.name: cancel_engagement
check_receipt
functions.doc:
Checks a receipt exactly as `submit_receipt` will, without recording
 it. Returns the receipt with its recovered signer, or fails with the
 same error the transaction would. Does not check replay.

functions.name: claim_owed
functions.doc: Pulls everything owed to the caller after a refused transfer.

functions.name: close_stale_claim
functions.doc:
Unwinds a quality claim no arbiter ruled on within `claim_window +
 appeal_window` of filing, so a missing arbiter can never lock funds
 forever. No fault is found: the client gets the price and the stake
 back, the vault keeps the premium, all locks are released, nobody is
 slashed and the agent's record is unchanged. Anyone may call it.

functions.name: complete
functions.doc:
Settles a delivered engagement once the claim window has closed with no
 claim: the price goes to the agent, the premium to the vault, and both
 locks are released. Anyone may call it.

functions.name: confirm_payout
functions.doc:
The keeper reports 1Click's final outcome for a delivered Intents
 payout (`status` is `SUCCESS`, `REFUNDED` or `FAILED`, `quote_id` must
 be the one it was sent with):

 * `SUCCESS` — final; `dest_tx` is recorded.
 * `FAILED`  — recorded; a later `REFUNDED` can still recover it.
 * `REFUNDED` — the award came back to this contract. It is matched
   from `unattributed` (tokens `sync_unattributed` has seen on the
   balance and nobody owns), so a report alone creates nothing; the
   payout is `Pending` again for a new quote.

functions.name: council_decide
functions.doc:
Council overturns or confirms an appealed arbiter verdict.
 Callable only by the configured Sputnik DAO council.
 If the arbiter is overturned, the arbiter is fined `min_bond` from its bond,
 which is paid to the appellant, and the appellant's appeal stake is refunded.
 If the arbiter is confirmed, the appellant loses its appeal stake to the other party.
 Slashes/finalizes the claim according to the council's verdict.

functions.name: create_vault
functions.doc:
Creates a vault owned by the caller. Attach enough to cover storage;
 the rest is refunded.

functions.name: deposit_vault
functions.doc:
Deposits the attached NEAR into `vault` and mints shares to the caller
 at the current price. A first-time LP pays for its share record out of
 the deposit; returns the shares minted. `min_shares` guards against the
 share price moving between quoting and execution.

functions.name: execute_payout
functions.doc:
Sends a pending payout. Keeper only. The amount is fixed by the
 verdict, the destination by the claimant, the mode at creation; the
 keeper chooses only *when* and, for Intents, supplies the 1Click quote
 for that fixed destination. A quote id or deposit address can be used
 once; Direct payouts take neither.

 Intents payouts attach more than `INTENTS_STORAGE_DEPOSIT`: exactly
 that registers the deposit address on the token, the storage this
 attempt adds here is kept, and the rest is refunded to the keeper.
 Direct payouts attach nothing.

 Trust note (T8): the deposit address and quote are relayed by the
 keeper and cannot be checked on-chain against the claimant's
 destination. They are recorded (with `quote_hash`, the sha256 of the
 raw quote) and emitted so anyone can check them against 1Click's
 public status for that deposit address; the keeper's bond is what
 answers for a mismatch.

functions.name: expire
functions.doc:
Closes an engagement that was never delivered and never claimed, once
 the no-delivery claim window has also passed, so no money stays locked
 forever. The price goes back to the client; the premium goes to the
 vault, which carried the risk for the whole period. Anyone may call it.

functions.name: file_claim
functions.doc:
Files a claim of `amount` against engagement `id`. Attach the stake
 (`claim_stake_bps` of `amount`, rounded up) plus the claim storage fee;
 any excess is refunded. The stake comes back if the claim is upheld and
 goes to the agent if it is rejected. `destination` is fixed now so no
 one can redirect the payout later (T8).

functions.name: finalize
functions.doc:
Applies an arbiter's verdict once the appeal window has passed. Anyone
 may call it. Upheld: the agent's bond and then the vault are slashed
 for the award, which becomes a pending payout to the claimant; the
 claimant's stake comes back now and the escrowed price stays with the
 vault (the award is the compensation). Rejected: the
 stake and the price go to the agent and the job counts as completed.

functions.name: ft_on_transfer
functions.doc:
NEP-141 receiver. Returns the amount to refund to the sender (0 when
 all of it was used). Panics on anything invalid, which refunds the
 sender in full.

functions.doc:
Settles a Direct payout from its transfer's outcome. Only this
 contract can call it.

functions.name: open_engagement
functions.doc:
Proposes one job to `agent`. Attach `price + premium + storage fee`
 (`quote_job` returns the exact figure); any excess is refunded. The
 money is escrowed; liability is locked only when the agent accepts.

 `price` is explicit rather than inferred from the deposit so that a
 premium change between quoting and signing makes the call fail instead
 of silently shrinking what the agent is paid.

functions.name: pause
functions.doc:
Stops NEW engagements only. Work in flight, claims, verdicts, slashes and
 payouts all continue — pausing must never trap a client's money.

functions.name: post_bond
functions.doc:
Adds the attached deposit to the caller's bond. The bond record was
 created (and its storage paid) at registration, and its size is fixed,
 so the whole deposit becomes bond.

functions.name: quote_job
functions.doc:
Prices a job for `agent` at `liability_cap` and says whether
 `open_engagement` would accept it. Pass `price` to check the liability
 ceiling and get the exact deposit to attach.

functions.name: remove_signer
functions.doc:
Removes a signer, e.g. after its attestation is revoked. Owner only:
 a keeper must not be able to switch off delivery for everyone.

functions.name: request_withdrawal
functions.doc:
Starts the cooldown for withdrawing `amount` of unlocked bond. A new
 request replaces any earlier one and restarts the cooldown.

functions.name: resolve_claim
functions.doc:
The arbiter rules on a quality claim. The verdict must carry the
 arbiter's own TEE receipt, verified on-chain exactly like a delivery
 receipt (and likewise usable only once), so every verdict can be traced
 to a specific attested model run that anyone can re-run. An upheld
 claim needs a positive award no larger than the claimed amount; a
 rejected one has an award of zero. Starts the appeal window.

functions.name: resolve_objective
functions.doc:
Upholds a no-delivery claim with no arbiter: the deadline passed and no
 receipt exists, which the contract can see for itself. Anyone may call
 it. The award is the full claimed amount; objective verdicts are not
 appealable, so the appeal deadline is the moment of decision.

functions.name: solvency
functions.doc:
Both sides of invariant I1. `ok` holds when what the contract holds,
 less what the runtime reserves for storage, covers every liability.

 `storage_balance_bounds().min` once for its own entry (kept as long as
 the entry exists); the rest is its available balance. With
 `registration_only`, only the minimum is kept and the rest refunded.

functions.name: storage_withdraw
functions.doc:
NEP-145: return unused prepaid storage (all of it if `amount` is
 omitted). Requires exactly 1 yoctoNEAR, so it needs a full-access key.

functions.name: submit_receipt
functions.doc:
The agent proves delivery with a TEE-signed receipt, checked on-chain
 (see `tee.rs`). Must arrive by the deadline, and each response hash can
 be used once across all engagements (T3).

functions.name: sync_unattributed
functions.doc:
Keeper only. Reads this contract's real token balance to find tokens
 that arrived by plain `ft_transfer` (1Click refunds). The read is
 taken in another receipt, so it is trusted only when nothing moved in
 between: no transfer in flight and the books unchanged from request
 to callback. Even then a deposit being refunded by the token can sit
 on the balance for a few blocks, so `unattributed` only rises to what
 two quiet reads at least `SYNC_GAP_NS` apart both saw; it falls at
 once.

 Residual risk: someone who lands a rejected deposit on *both* reads
 can still overstate it. That only matters together with a false
 `REFUNDED` report, i.e. a dishonest keeper, which the keeper bond
 answers for (as with the deposit address, T8).

functions.name: withdraw
functions.doc:
Pays out the requested amount once the cooldown has passed, provided no
 claim is open and the amount is still unlocked.

Bond.description: An agent's own collateral. `locked` is the sum of `bond_locked` across its open engagements; it can never exceed `amount` (invariant I2) and `amount` can never drop below it (invariant I4).

open_claims.description: Claims filed against this agent that are not yet finalized. While non-zero, nothing can be withdrawn (invariant I4, threat T4).

withdrawal_amount.description: How much the pending request will withdraw. Excluded from what new engagements may lock, so a requested withdrawal cannot be trapped.

withdrawal_requested_at.description: Set by `request_withdrawal`; restarted if a claim is filed during the cooldown.

BondAsset.description: What bonds, vault capital, prices and payouts are denominated in.

oneOf.description: Objective: resolves on-chain with no arbiter. Anyone may call `resolve_objective`.
Subjective: the work arrived but is wrong. Goes to the arbiter.
Waiting for a verdict.

Config.description: Set once at `new()`, readable by anyone via `get_config`. Never mutated except through an explicit migration.

appeal_window.description: How long after a verdict either side may appeal. 3 min / 48 h.

base_bond_share_bps.description: Share of liability the agent's own bond must cover before the track-record discount (5000 = 50%), and the floor it falls to (2000 = 20%).

bid_commit_window.description: Underwriter sealed-bid timing (Phase 4). 60 s / 1 h each.

claim_stake_bps.description: Claimant stakes this share of the claim; lost if the claim is rejected. 500 = 5%.

claim_window.description: How long after delivery a client may claim. 3 min / 72 h.

council.description: Sputnik DAO v2 account. The ONLY account that can decide appeals (Phase 3).

max_vault_exposure_bps.description: One agent may use at most this share of a vault's capital. 2500 = 25%.

min_bond.description: Smallest bond an agent may post. 5 NEAR sandbox/testnet, 2 USDC mainnet.

withdrawal_cooldown.description: Between asking to withdraw and withdrawing. 5 min / 7 days.

Counters.description: The next id each kind of record will get. Ids start at 0 and never repeat.

limit.description: Most this vault will have locked for this agent at any one time.

oneOf.description: The client has escrowed price + premium; waiting for the agent to accept. Nothing is locked yet.
Accepted: liability locked; waiting for a receipt.
Receipt accepted; the claim window is running.
A claim was filed and is not yet settled.

premium_bps.description: The bound coverage's premium rate, if any.

storage_fee.description: Prepaid storage for the engagement and its receipt, in yoctoNEAR. Native mode: part of the attached deposit. Ft mode: taken from the client's NEP-145 storage balance.

total_deposit.description: What to send, when `price` was given. Native mode: `price + premium + storage_fee` to attach. Ft mode: `price + premium` in the token, sent with `ft_transfer_call`.

vault_available.description: Vault capital the agent can still lock in its coverage vault.

vault_share.description: Locked from the backing vault: `liability_cap - required_bond`.

Signed text is "<request_hash>:<response_hash>".

Signer.description: An allow-listed TEE signing address, registered only after an off-chain attestation check with a fresh nonce.

Solvency.description: Both sides of invariant I1, as returned by `solvency()`.

held.description: The contract's balance, as the runtime reports it.

liabilities.description: Sum of the buckets above, plus prepaid NEP-145 storage in native mode.

storage_ok.description: The NEAR balance covers locked storage plus prepaid NEP-145 balances.

storage_reserved.description: Part of `held` the runtime keeps aside to pay for the contract's storage.

surplus.description: `held - storage_reserved - liabilities`, or 0 if that would be negative.

Totals.description: Running sums of every bucket of money the contract owes someone — the right-hand side of invariant I1. Kept in step with the individual records on every write; the invariant tests check both agree.

claim_stakes.description: Stakes of every claim that is not yet settled.

escrow.description: Price + premium of every engagement that is not yet settled.

pending_payouts.description: Payouts owed but not yet sent (status `Pending`).

capital.description: Everything the LPs own: deposits + premiums - losses - redemptions.

locked.description: Capital backing open engagements. `locked <= capital` (invariant I2).

prices_retained.description: Prices of jobs whose claims were upheld. The client is compensated by the award, so the price stays with the vault that paid it (T6).
